label: PLC DB74 → InfluxDB (S7 Live)
info: S7-1500 DB74 全點位讀取，寫入 InfluxDB real_time_data

name: DB74 → InfluxDB line protocol
func:
// DB74 全點位 → InfluxDB line protocol
// msg.payload 為 S7 In 輸出的物件 {tag_code: value, ...}

var deviceMap = {
    VALVE_DN1350_CMD_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_CMD_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_FB_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_REMOTE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_CMD_ALARM: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_SPARE_1: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_SPARE_2: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_IN_CMD_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_IN_CMD_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_FB_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_IN_FILL_CMD_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_IN_FILL_CMD_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_IN_FILL_FB_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_IN_FILL_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_CMD_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_CMD_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FB_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FILL_CMD_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FILL_CMD_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FILL_FB_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FILL_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN900_CMD_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN900_CMD_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN900_FB_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN900_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN900_FILL_CMD_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN900_FILL_CMD_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN900_FILL_FB_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN900_FILL_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1800_QSD: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1800_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1800_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_OPV_FB_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_OPV_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_OPV_ALARM: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_PRESS_IN: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_PRESS_OUT: "valve",
    VALVE_OPV_PRESS_WATER: "valve",
    VALVE_OPV_PRESS_HYD: "valve",
    HPU_TURB_MOTOR: "hpu",
    HPU_TURB_QSD_VALVE: "hpu",
    HPU_TURB_BRAKE: "hpu",
    HPU_TURB_DN900_VALVE: "hpu",
    HPU_TURB_DN1400_VALVE: "hpu",
    HPU_BYPASS_MOTOR: "hpu",
    HPU_BYPASS_CIRC_VALVE: "hpu",
    HPU_BYPASS_DN1400_VALVE: "hpu",
    HPU_PRESS_TURB1: "hpu",
    HPU_PRESS_BYPASS2: "hpu",
    SYS_UPS_ALARM: "control",
    SYS_SHUTDOWN_ALARM: "control",
    CTRL_TEMP: "control",
    TURB_GUIDE_VANE_RAW: "turbine",
    TURB_GUIDE_VANE: "turbine",
    TURB_FLOW_IN: "turbine",
    TURB_PRESS_BEFORE: "turbine",
    TURB_PRESS_AFTER: "turbine",
    CALC_FLOW_PLUNGER: "turbine",
    CALC_FLOW_TURBINE: "turbine",
    ENV_WATER_IN: "environment",
    ENV_WATER_OUT: "environment",
    ENV_NOISE_IN: "environment",
    ENV_NOISE_OUT: "environment",
    GEN_POWER_P: "generator",
    GEN_POWER_Q: "generator",
    GEN_POWER_S: "generator",
    GEN_TEMP_U: "generator",
    GEN_TEMP_V: "generator",
    GEN_TEMP_W: "generator",
    GEN_TEMP_ENV: "generator",
    GEN_BEAR_TEMP_DE: "generator",
    GEN_BEAR_TEMP_NDE: "generator",
    GEN_VIB_DE: "generator",
    GEN_VIB_NDE: "generator",
    GEN_SPEED_PCT: "generator",
    GEN_SPEED: "generator",
    ELEC_CURR_L1: "electrical",
    ELEC_CURR_L2: "electrical",
    ELEC_CURR_L3: "electrical",
    ELEC_CURR_L1P: "electrical",
    ELEC_CURR_L2P: "electrical",
    ELEC_CURR_L3P: "electrical",
    ELEC_VOLT_AB: "electrical",
    ELEC_VOLT_BC: "electrical",
    ELEC_VOLT_CA: "electrical",
    CALC_FLOW_TOTAL: "general"
};

var data = msg.payload;
var lines = [];

for (var tag in data) {
    var device = deviceMap[tag] || "unknown";
    var val = data[tag];
    if (typeof val === "boolean") {
        val = val ? 1 : 0;
    }
    lines.push(
        "measurements,plant_id=hushan,tag_code=" + tag + ",device_code=" + device + " value=" + val
    );
}

msg.payload = lines.join("\n");
msg.headers = {
    "Authorization": "Token 填入你的InfluxDB_Token",
    "Content-Type": "text/plain"
};
msg.url = "http://localhost:8086/api/v2/write?org=SCADA_hushan&bucket=real_time_data&precision=ms";
return msg;
